ABC Atlas cell-type annotations

This prototype adds categorical cell annotations requested in Jing Zhu’s feedback. It uses Zhuang-ABCA-2, one adult wild-type male mouse. It does not add a new MERFISH gene-expression matrix or combine these cells with the existing Allen ISH experiments.

What was reviewed

  • ABC Atlas overview: the Zhuang whole-mouse MERFISH collection is distinct from the related Zeng collection.
  • The supplied notebook index covers Hongkui Zeng’s collection. It also links the dedicated Zhuang datasets and tutorial used here.
  • Interactive ABC Atlas: the shared viewer URL encodes client-side display state. That state is not treated as evidence of a dataset identity; the specimen was chosen explicitly from Jing’s recommendation.
  • Zhuang MERFISH tutorial documents the cell metadata, taxonomy joins, confidence filtering and CCF-coordinate join.

Data and processing

The source is the official Allen public S3 release manifest 20250531. Metadata version 20241115, registered CCF-coordinate version 20230830, and WMB taxonomy version 20231215 are pinned. All six processing inputs passed the manifest’s MD5 checks; their SHA-256 checksums are recorded in the metadata download.

StageCell count
Source cell metadata1,227,408

Cell IDs remain strings, preserving the full identifiers. Published point coordinates are rounded to six decimal places in millimeters and confidence scores to four decimal places. Taxonomy and confidence scores are joined by exact keys. Regional counts use every eligible labeled, registered cell; selecting a parent region includes its source descendant labels. These are counts within the supplied dataset, not an unbiased census, physical density, or estimates of the living mouse’s population.

Display sampling retains IDs whose SHA-256 first 32 bits are divisible by eight. This deterministic approximately 1/8 sample does not select by cell class, gene expression, confidence score, or brain region. It can omit rare types in the plotted dots even when the full-source count is nonzero.

Coordinates and anatomical limits

Only the supplied CCF coordinates are plotted; reconstructed section coordinates are not substituted. Allen’s AP/DV/ML coordinates in millimeters are transformed into the viewer’s RAS frame using the source NIfTI axes and origin. The ABC annotation_25 and existing template share those axes and origin. No mirroring, symmetry filling or coordinate interpolation is applied.

An independent nearest-voxel check against the official 25 µm annotation agrees with the supplied region label for 92.81% of 10,357 audited cells. Source assignments are retained for mismatches; this diagnostic does not establish exact cell-level anatomical accuracy. Registration, sampling resolution and atlas boundaries impose limits. Coverage is uneven and can be unilateral; an empty region or hemisphere does not establish absence of that cell type.

The 3D dots are cell centers, not reconstructed cell shapes. Slice dots show sampled cells within ±50 µm of the current plane. Their colors follow the selected taxonomy level. Class and subclass labels are transcriptomic assignments; neurotransmitter annotation is not a direct measurement of transmitter release. Individual records retain source subclass/cluster confidence and high-quality-transfer flags. Confidence is not a disease probability.

Different kinds of color

Anatomy colors identify regions. ISH expression is a continuous image-analysis signal summarized per region from separate experiments. ABC cell types are categorical cell labels. They are separate modes and should not be interpreted as simultaneous measurements of the same cells.

Free access and open-source plans

The prototype is freely accessible without an account. We plan to make GEAR-XR software free and open source; the public repository contains the processing script, source manifest, validation records and viewer code. A project-wide software license and third-party asset review are still pending, so this is not a claim that every repository asset already has an open-source software license.

ABC/Zhuang data are shared under CC BY 4.0. BigBrain anatomy has separate noncommercial share-alike terms; its license is not replaced by the ABC data license. Existing dependencies and other datasets retain their own licenses.
